name: proof-pi-e2e-wait
about: QA proofs (docs/decisions/2026-10-18-qa-proofs.md), the pi and e2e kinds: nothing runs pi checks yet (the test Pi device is not on main) and these e2e tests are in no regression run, so they wait and never verify the item (#195: scenarios 73-…). The build's proof: a command, a pi check and an e2e check. The command passes on the first pass; the thread says what it still waits for, the board shows it under waiting for a proof, and an hour later nothing more is checked. The user can always verify it by hand.
